name: field
body: A template field definition: name, type, rules (required, default, max_length — characters after Markdown stripping, min/max_items, min/max, plain, description), display formats for number/date (input is always a plain YAML number / `YYYY-MM-DD`). A field additionally carries `nullable` (default false; nullable-fields); a `text` field may carry `coerce` (text-coercion); and a `list` field may carry `max_items_from`/`min_items_from` referencing another list (cross-field-list-constraints). A required field that declares a default is satisfied when omitted — the default is applied — everywhere a `fields` map is validated (slide and section instances, template examples, `section` helper calls and `child` constructor calls; field-rules). A `fields` map supplied to the `section` helper or to a `child` constructor is checked against that template's field schema by the same rules (section-helper, child-constructor).
